confirm_update_hosts.title: Confirm to update hosts
confirm_update_hosts.add_records_info: Entries of type <codeTag>0.0.0.0 domain</codeTag> will be added for the following domains in the <regionTag>{{region}}</regionTag> region:

setup.welcome.description: Thank you for installing the application. Let's quickly set up the core preferences for you. You can change these settings at any time by clicking the gear icon in the left sidebar.

settings.title: Application settings
settings.description: Here you can configure the application settings.
settings.firewall_about: Blocks connections at the network level. Works even if the game uses IP addresses directly. Requires administrator privileges.
settings.backups_about: After cleaning, it creates a .bak file in the hosts folder.

sync_mode.title: Synchronization
sync_mode.local_text: You have chosen the local approach; we will take the cluster file from your PC.
sync_mode.hybrid_text: You have chosen the hybrid approach; we will update the cluster file from the GitHub repository. If it is unavailable, we will enable the local copy.
sync_mode.server_text: You have chosen the server approach; we will take the cluster file only from the GitHub repository.

clear.title: Clear Hosts{{firewall}}
clear.description: This will remove all sections and rules added by the application from the hosts file and firewall.{{backup}} Are you sure?
clear.backup: A backup will be created automatically.

admin_privileges.title: Administrator privileges required
admin_privileges.description: The application does not have permission to modify the system hosts file. To use the server blocking/unblocking functionality, run the application as administrator.

how_to_open_app_admin_privilege.title: How to run as administrator
how_to_open_app_admin_privilege.description: Run the application as administrator (right-click → Run as administrator) or create a shortcut and in its properties select the option to run as administrator. After that, click 'Retry'.

blocking_all_confirm.title: Confirm blocking all servers
blocking_all_confirm.description: You are about to block all servers in the {{region}} region. This will cause the game to be unable to connect to servers in this region — you will effectively disable access to the game in this region.

available.title: Update v{{version}} available
available.download: A new version is ready to download
available.install: A new version is ready to install

completed.title: Update installed!
completed.description: The application will restart in a few seconds

admin_mounts.title: Administrator rights error
admin_mounts.description: To clear the locks, you need to run the application with administrator privileges.
admin_mounts.details: Please close the application and launch it as an administrator.

tauri.unavailable: Tauri is unavailable — please run the desktop application
